failure_summary.description: Agents repeated base searches instead of retrieving compatible cached results and applying the newly supplied budget filter.
Agents failed to save the returned result object, using an undefined variable or the tool function itself as the cache value.
An agent failed to carry an established trip span and traveler count into an explicitly requested hotel search.

patch.reasoning: The skill already explicitly covers cached filtering and saving the returned result, so repeating those instructions would not address a document gap. It does not clearly state that dates and party size from an established trip apply to lodging requested for that same itinerary; the addition makes that cross-domain context explicit.

edits.content: - When lodging is explicitly requested as part of the same itinerary as a round-trip flight, carry the established trip span to the hotel search unless the user gives different lodging dates: use the outbound date as check-in and the return date as checkout when the hotel is at the destination. Carry an explicitly stated traveler count to the hotel’s supported `num_people` field as well. Do not ask again for dates or party size already established for that trip.
